subject.title: feat(reef): follow up on unconfirmed deliveries instead of staying silent

question: Should Reef adopt a ten-minute owner wake-up contract for unconfirmed outbound sends, including a peer-scoped completion notice when a receipt later arrives?
rationale: This is a new user-visible agent-notification policy with a fixed timing threshold and session-routing semantics; the protected maintainer label means the product contract should be explicitly sponsored rather than inferred from implementation alone.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded notification contract
options.body: Keep the feature, but require peer-scoped late follow-ups, relay-acceptance eligibility, focused regression coverage, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the notification policy
options.body: Defer the new owner wake-up behavior until maintainers choose the desired timeout, routing, and notification-volume contract for Reef.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded notification contract
recommendation.body: Keep the feature, but require peer-scoped late follow-ups, relay-acceptance eligibility, focused regression coverage, and redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Reef lifecycle work and this delivery-path proposal make this the closest available routing candidate.
